notes: All surgical and experimental procedures in this study were in compliance with the National Institutes of Health Guidelines for the Care and Use of Laboratory Animals and were approved by the Rice University Institutional Animal Care and Use Committee (protocol IACUC-25-188).
experiment_description: Behavioral and electrophysiological investigation of cortical plasticity induced by repeated ICMS in primary somatosensory cortex (S1-trunk). Mice were trained on an ICMS-cued wheel-turn detection task while multi-channel extracellular recordings were collected via chronic 32-channel linear NET probes.
